# Try pressing RIGHT with intent='re-explore' to see if we can move

# Check new player position
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
player2 = None
for n in seg2['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b':
        player2 = n
        break
if player2:
    pc2 = (sum(p[0] for p in player2['boundary'])//len(player2['boundary']), sum(p[1] for p in player2['boundary'])//len(player2['boundary']))

</function>
